usage.outputShape: Intended: body.data[].embedding (OpenAI embeddings shape). Not observed — endpoint returned body.error.message instead.

usage.guide: This endpoint is currently broken. It is an OpenAI-compatible embeddings API (POST with {model, input}) on the Spraay gateway, but it charges $0.005 via x402 and then returns HTTP 502 because its upstream Chutes AI embeddings route returns 404. Do not call it — payment is taken with no result. If revisiting, confirm the gateway's upstream is restored before paying.
